summary: Yellowstone is America's first national park, home to dramatic geysers, vibrant hot springs, wildlife-filled valleys, and breathtaking canyons. This volcanic wonderland offers unparalleled photography opportunities and world-class outdoor adventures across 3,500 square miles of pristine wilderness. From the iconic Old Faithful geyser to the grand Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone delivers nature at its most spectacular and awe-inspiring.

restaurants.name: Old Faithful Inn Dining Room
restaurants.description: Historic 1903 restaurant with soaring wooden beam ceilings overlooking the iconic geyser. Fine American cuisine with regional bison and trout specialties.
restaurants.mustTry: Grilled bison ribeye with wild mushroom sauce

restaurants.name: Mammoth Hot Springs Hotel Dining Room
restaurants.description: Classic lodge dining with mountain views and hearty American comfort food. Popular for breakfast buffets and evening steaks.

restaurants.name: Canyon Village Dining Room
restaurants.description: Family-friendly restaurant with contemporary décor serving traditional American fare with local game options. Great for groups and families.

restaurants.name: Terrace Grill
restaurants.description: Quick-service cafeteria-style dining at Mammoth Hot Springs offering grab-and-go options and casual meals. Perfect for park visitors on the move.

restaurants.name: Lake Hotel Deli
restaurants.description: Casual deli counter with sandwiches, salads, and quick snacks. Ideal for lunch before afternoon wildlife viewing excursions.
restaurants.mustTry: Roast beef sandwich on fresh bread

restaurants.name: Grant Village Restaurant
restaurants.description: Lakeside restaurant with panoramic views of Yellowstone Lake and seasonal American cuisine. Excellent for sunset dining experiences.

restaurants.name: Norris Geyser Basin Snack Shop
restaurants.description: Small snack bar serving light fare, beverages, and quick meals perfect for geyser exploring and trail breaks.

restaurants.name: Old West Steakhouse (West Yellowstone)
restaurants.description: Authentic steakhouse outside park gates with wood-fired ambiance and premium Montana beef. Local favorite with rustic charm.

restaurants.name: Gardiner Grill (Gardiner)
restaurants.description: Family-owned restaurant specializing in Montana game and regional produce. Warm atmosphere with local wildlife photographs.

restaurants.name: Cooke City Store & Deli
restaurants.description: Historic general store with deli counter offering hearty sandwiches and supplies for backcountry adventures. Quaint mountain town vibe.

restaurants.name: Explorer Peak Café (Canyon Village)
restaurants.description: Casual café with espresso, pastries, and breakfast items. Perfect morning stop before exploring the park.
restaurants.mustTry: Fresh blueberry muffin with local honey

restaurants.name: Paradise Valley Prime (Livingston)
restaurants.description: Upscale Montana restaurant featuring locally-sourced ingredients and artisanal preparations. Sophisticated dining with mountain views.
restaurants.mustTry: Pan-seared duck breast with cherry gastrique

activities.name: Old Faithful Geyser Viewing
activities.description: Watch the iconic geyser erupt approximately every 90 minutes, shooting water 130 feet into the air. The visitor center provides eruption predictions and geological education.

activities.name: Grand Prismatic Spring Walk
activities.description: Hike around the largest hot spring in the USA with brilliant blues, greens, and yellows created by heat-loving bacteria. The elevated overlook trail provides panoramic views.

activities.name: Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone Tour
activities.description: Experience the dramatic 1,200-foot canyon with the thundering Lower Falls and Artist Point views. Multiple viewpoints accessible via easy walks or short hikes.

activities.name: Lamar Valley Wildlife Viewing
activities.description: Explore the 'Serengeti of North America' with chances to see bison, elk, wolves, grizzly bears, and eagles. Best at dawn and dusk with wildlife spotters throughout.

activities.name: Norris Geyser Basin Self-Guided Loop
activities.description: Walk among geysers, hot springs, and fumaroles on well-maintained trails through geothermal features. Steamboat Geyser and Porcelain Spring are highlights.

activities.name: Backcountry Hiking Expedition
activities.description: Venture into remote wilderness on multi-day hiking trips with bear safety protocols and wilderness camping permits. Solitude and pristine landscapes reward dedicated hikers.

activities.name: Yellowstone Lake Boat Tour
activities.description: Cruise the massive alpine lake with ranger-narrated interpretations of geology, wildlife, and history. Scenic mountain vistas and possible wildlife sightings from the water.

activities.name: Mammoth Hot Springs Terraces Walk
activities.description: Explore white mineral travertine terraces sculpted by hot spring activity. Both upper and lower terrace loops offer stunning geological formations and easy accessibility.

activities.name: Lower Geyser Basin Mud Volcano Trail
activities.description: Hike past bubbling mud pots, sulfur vents, and colorful hot springs creating an otherworldly landscape. Interpretive signs explain geothermal activity and microorganisms.

activities.name: Guided Fishing Excursion
activities.description: Fish for cutthroat and lake trout with ranger-led trips or private guides in pristine mountain waters. Fly-fishing instruction available for beginners.

activities.name: Evening Wildlife Viewing & Photo Shoot
activities.description: Professional-led evening excursions to photograph elk, bison, and birds during golden hour. Expert guides help position photographers for optimal compositions.

activities.name: Winter Snowcoach Adventure
activities.description: Experience Yellowstone's winter landscape via heated snowcoach touring geysers and wildlife viewing in snow-covered terrain. December-March seasonal adventure.

spots.name: Old Faithful at Sunrise
spots.description: Capture the geyser eruption backlit by golden sunrise light with steam clouds creating dramatic silhouettes against pastel skies.

spots.name: Grand Prismatic Spring Overlook
spots.description: Photograph the largest hot spring's vivid blue center and rainbow-colored edges from the elevated boardwalk trail with wide-angle vistas.

spots.name: Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone - Artist Point
spots.description: Iconic viewpoint of the Lower Falls framed by canyon walls, best captured with dramatic lighting during golden hour or stormy skies.

spots.name: Lamar Valley Wildlife Corridor
spots.description: Photograph elk herds, bison, wolves, and eagles in open grassland with mountain backdrop. Best during dawn light for animal silhouettes.

spots.name: Mammoth Hot Springs Upper Terraces
spots.description: Capture white travertine formations with steaming pools and thermal features creating layers of interesting textures and color.

spots.name: Porcelain Spring - Norris Basin
spots.description: Photograph delicate blue hot spring surrounded by white mineral deposits with intricate thermal runoff patterns creating abstract compositions.

spots.name: Tower Falls with Rainbow Light
spots.description: Capture the 132-foot waterfall through mist-filled air with possible rainbow effects when sun angle aligns with water spray.

spots.name: Midway Geyser Basin Thermal Features
spots.description: Photograph colorful geothermal pools with steam and mineral-stained edges creating otherworldly compositions with natural leading lines.
spots.bestTime: 10:00 AM-3:00 PM for color and steam contrast

spots.name: Pelican Valley Grizzly Bear Territory
spots.description: Advanced backcountry location to photograph grizzly bears in natural habitat with valley landscape backdrop. Requires bear safety protocols.

spots.name: Castle Geyser at Dawn
spots.description: Photograph the distinctive cone geyser with eruption steam backlit by sunrise, creating ethereal light and dramatic silhouettes.

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for expansive landscapes and thermal features
70-200mm telephoto for wildlife and distant mountain subjects
100-400mm zoom for distant wildlife and birds
50mm prime for environmental portraits and thermal detail shots
photography.goldenHourNotes: Yellowstone's high elevation (7,000-9,000 feet) creates extended golden hours with dramatic light angles. Summer provides 14+ hours of daylight enabling maximum shooting flexibility. Golden hour light transforms geothermal steam into luminescent clouds and creates spectacular backlighting opportunities for wildlife and thermal features. Winter offers intense low-angle sun and snow-enhanced reflections creating surreal compositions.

weather.seasonality: Summer (June-August) offers warm temperatures, full park access, and abundant wildlife viewing. Winter (December-March) transforms Yellowstone into a pristine white landscape with limited road access but stunning snowcoach adventures and solitude. Spring and fall provide moderate temperatures, fewer crowds, and optimal photography conditions.
weather.summary: Yellowstone experiences dramatic seasonal variation with cold, snowy winters and mild summers. Summer temperatures range 15-25°C with occasional afternoon thunderstorms, while winters drop to -15°C with significant snowfall making some areas inaccessible. The shoulder seasons of spring and fall provide ideal conditions with moderate temperatures and lower visitor numbers.

hotels.name: Old Faithful Inn
hotels.description: Historic 1903 lodge with iconic architecture, wood-beamed ceilings, and direct views of Old Faithful geyser. Classic Yellowstone experience with comfortable modernized rooms.

hotels.name: Canyon Village Lodge
hotels.description: Contemporary lodge near Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone with modern amenities, multiplex restaurants, and convenient access to canyon trails and viewpoints.

hotels.name: Mammoth Hot Springs Hotel
hotels.description: Premium historic hotel featuring ornate architecture, fine dining, spa services, and direct access to thermal features. Offers thermal pool and upscale accommodations.
